$comment: The ONLY identities allowed in a commit of the org (founder 2026-11-04, krizaka-internal#2433): author, committer and Co-authored-by trailers. No e-mail is ever invented. Read by scripts/check-trailers.mjs (security-scan.yml) and by the local hooks of krizaka-agents (fetched pinned to the same sha as the security workflows). Change it by pull request only; a new Krizaka GitHub App is added with its exact id (gh api users/<slug>%5Bbot%5D --jq .id), never a wildcard.
